concept: Multi-Token Prediction Speculative Verification and Draft Amortization
summary: Source-anchored research for Multi-Token Prediction Speculative Verification and Draft Amortization. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: When speculative verification achieves an acceptance rate greater than 60%, end-to-end token generation throughput increases by 25% to 45% on memory-bandwidth-constrained devices. (high confidence)

Speculative decoding amortizes parameter weight memory loading across K candidate tokens by evaluating candidate sequences as a small parallel GEMM batch instead of K sequential GEMV reads. (high confidence)
